chunk: title: Canonical Inventory Record — Education Vertical
standard: derived (no formal K-12 inventory standard; modeled from OAGIS ItemMaster + publisher conventions)

deviations:
  - Dual-source architecture: demand quantities from spreadsheet (UC3), cost values from QuickBooks (UC4)
  - 3% buffer threshold is business-specific (AgileMind — Intensified Algebra Vol 1, Intensified Integrated Math Vol 1)
  - ISBN is the primary product identifier (state-specific)
  - Committed stock = pipeline at ≥50% probability stage (Salesforce Opportunity)

description: >
  Canonical inventory record for K-12 educational publishers tracking print student activity book (SAB)
  inventory. Designed for dual-source sync: UC3 reads demand/quantity data from Holly's spreadsheet,
  UC4 reads cost/value data from QuickBooks inventory items. Both write to Salesforce Inventory__c.
  Field ownership is split to avoid overwrite conflicts.

required:
  - inventoryId
  - isbn
  - titleName
  - quantityOnHand
  - lastSyncedAt

properties:
  inventoryId:
    type: string
    description: Salesforce Inventory__c record ID
    sourceSystem: Salesforce
  isbn:
    type: string
    description: State-specific ISBN — primary key for upsert (composite with titleName slug)
    sourceSystem: both
  titleName:
    type: string
    description: Curriculum book title (e.g. Intensified Algebra Volume 1 SAB)
    sourceSystem: both
  quantityOnHand:
    type: integer
    description: Current physical stock count
    sourceSystem: QuickBooks (UC4) or Spreadsheet (UC3)
    fieldOwner: UC4 (QuickBooks path preferred)
  quantityCommitted:
    type: integer
    description: Units reserved for closed-won agreements and high-probability pipeline
    sourceSystem: Spreadsheet (UC3)
    fieldOwner: UC3
  quantityAvailable:
    type: integer
    description: quantityOnHand - quantityCommitted
    sourceSystem: computed
  bufferThreshold:
    type: number
    description: Safety stock buffer as a decimal (e.g. 0.03 = 3%); title-specific
    sourceSystem: Spreadsheet (UC3) or hardcoded in flow config
    fieldOwner: UC3
  projectedShort:
    type: boolean
    description: True when quantityAvailable < (quantityCommitted × bufferThreshold); drives shortage alert
    sourceSystem: computed in Salesforce Flow / MuleSoft transform
  unitCost:
    type: number
    description: Cost per unit (USD) — sourced from QuickBooks inventory item
    sourceSystem: QuickBooks (UC4)
    fieldOwner: UC4
  totalInventoryValue:
    type: number
